beats.say: Got a text saying your parcel is stuck and you must pay a small fee?
The fee is tiny so you do not think twice, but they want your card details.
Real delivery companies let you track parcels on their own app or website.
So never tap the link in the text. Open the official site yourself and check.
If you already entered card details, call your bank straight away using the number on your card.
Delete the next fake text today, and send this to someone who shops online.
